resources.string: Counts the short videos you swipe through in Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat Spotlight, TikTok, Moj and Josh, shows a counter while you watch, and takes you out of them when you reach your daily limit. It looks only at which screen is open, reads no text or messages, and keeps the count on this phone.
Reels, Shorts and Spotlight from every app go into one count. A counter shows on screen while you watch.

Open Accessibility settings, tap Reel Counter under Downloaded apps, and turn it on. If the switch is greyed out, open App info for Reel Counter, tap the ⋮ menu and choose Allow restricted settings first.
Reel Counter is on · daily limit %1$d

OnePlus and other phones stop apps to save battery, which turns counting off. Allow Reel Counter to run in the background. On OnePlus, also open Recent apps, tap Reel Counter\'s ⋮ menu and choose Lock.
Limit reached. Reels, Shorts and Spotlight are blocked until tomorrow. The rest of each app still works.
You\'ve watched %1$d reels today. Your limit is %2$d.
Reels and Shorts open again tomorrow. The rest of the app still works, and you can change your limit in Reel Counter.
This app will kill your time
You could do something productive instead.
You\'ve opened social apps %1$d times today.
Close app and do something useful
Opened social apps %1$d times today · %2$d more before the pause screen starts
Opened social apps %1$d times today · next pause %2$d s
See how long you spend in each social media app, using the same Android data as Digital Wellbeing. Tap below, find Reel Counter and turn on Permit usage access.
No social media use yet today.
Floats at the top of the screen while you watch. Curious while the count is low, electric when you scroll too fast, angry at your limit.
Block Reels and Shorts when I reach my limit
Show the counter while I watch
Pause before opening social apps (after 5 opens a day)
Any number from 1 to 999. Changes apply right away.
Today\'s reel count and app opens go back to 0. Earlier days stay as they are.
A reel is counted each time you swipe to a new one. The first video you open in a session isn\'t counted until you swipe.
